summary: Use a color legend at bottom-left to find diagonal marker pairs of matching color, then fill the rectangle between them with the adjacent legend color.
src: diagonal pixel pair s with same color forming opposite corners of a rectangle (upper corner pixel)
dst: diagonal pixel pair d with same color forming opposite corners of a rectangle (lower corner pixel)
match_cond: s.color == d.color && s and d are diagonally opposite
transform: fill rectangle bounded by s and d with color from legend where legend.left == s.color gives fill_color = legend.right
symbol_instructions: legend is vertical stack of color pairs at bottom-left, each pair (left-right only) has marker color on left and fill color on right
multi_step: Step 1: identify legend as vertically stacked color pairs at bottom-left corner; Step 2: process legend entries from bottom to top; Step 3: for each legend entry (marker_color on left, fill_color on right), find all diagonal pairs of marker_color pixels; Step 4: fill rectangle between each diagonal pair with fill_color
notes: sometimes as 2x2 squares which count as two diagonal triangles; processing order matters for overlapping regions
